n54442f735ff.s: The Anandpur Sahib Resolution, a State autonomy demand, is associated with which State?
n54442f735ff.x: The Anandpur Sahib Resolution came from Punjab; the Rajamannar Committee belongs to Tamil Nadu.

n941388c9131.s: How many members did the Rajamannar Committee, appointed by the Tamil Nadu Government, have?
n941388c9131.x: The Rajamannar Committee had three members; it was appointed by the Tamil Nadu Government.

ne3ddd23e46b.s: The complete deletion of Article 356 was demanded by the:
ne3ddd23e46b.x: Deleting Article 356 was the Rajamannar Committee's demand; the ARC recommended an Inter-State Council and non-partisan Governors.

n66bf828c34d.s: A new All India Service can be created after a resolution supported by two-thirds of members present and voting in the:
n66bf828c34d.x: The resolution must be passed by the Rajya Sabha, not the Lok Sabha.

n169fd2814c0.s: Who chairs the Inter-State Council set up in 1990 under Article 263?
n169fd2814c0.x: The Prime Minister chairs the Inter-State Council; the Home Minister chairs its Standing Committee.

nbac55bed984.s: Which of the following strengthens local fiscal devolution rather than being cited in the centralisation critique?
nbac55bed984.x: State Finance Commissions strengthen local fiscal devolution; cesses, CSS and GST are cited as centralising.

n2c3eaeecda5.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: P.V. Rajamannar – former Chief Justice, Bombay High Court
P.V. Rajamannar – former Chief Justice, Madras High Court
n2c3eaeecda5.x: P.V. Rajamannar was a former Chief Justice of the Madras High Court; the committee was appointed in 1969 and reported in 1971.

n1b4265820ba.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rajamannar Committee:
1. It found that central dominance had turned the States into 'administrative units of the Centre'.
2. It identified Articles 280 and 282 as the main instruments of this overreach.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n1b4265820ba.x: Statement 1 is correct; the Articles it named as enabling overreach were 256, 257 and 365, not 280 and 282.

nf50c41755cb.s: According to the Sarkaria Commission, a Governor should be:
o: Closely involved in the local politics of the State
An eminent person from outside the State
An active politician in the recent past
Appointed without consulting the Chief Minister
nf50c41755cb.x: Sarkaria favoured an eminent person from outside the State, not recently active in politics, with the Chief Minister consulted.

new.s: In 2015, the Planning Commission was replaced by:
new.x: The Planning Commission was replaced by NITI Aayog in 2015.

new.s: The CPI(M) memorandum on State autonomy was presented by West Bengal's Left Front government in:
new.x: West Bengal's CPI(M) memorandum came in 1977, after Tamil Nadu (1969) and Punjab (1973).

new.s: Which was cited as an argument against greater State autonomy, in the interest of national unity?
new.x: Punjab militancy of the 1980s is cited against greater autonomy on grounds of unity.

new.s: The National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution (2000) was chaired by:
new.x: The NCRWC was chaired by former CJI M.N. Venkatachaliah; Punchhi headed the 2007 commission.

new.s: The Punchhi Commission on Centre-State relations was appointed by the Centre in:
new.x: The Punchhi Commission was appointed on 27 April 2007 and reported on 30 March 2010.

new.s: Which body recommended that the Governor give assent to Bills within about four months?
o: National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution
new.x: The NCRWC recommended assent within about four months.

new.s: Cesses are criticised in federalism debates mainly because they:
o: Are not shared with the States
Are levied only by the States
Are fixed by the Finance Commission
new.x: Cesses (about 18% of gross tax revenue) are not shared with the States.

new.s: Under the All India Services, control over officers is divided as:
o: Ultimate and immediate control both with the Centre
Ultimate control with the Centre, immediate with the States
Ultimate control with the States, immediate with the Centre
new.x: AIS officers are under the ultimate control of the Centre and the immediate control of the States.

new.s: Article 312 deals with the All India Services, which include IAS, IPS and:
new.x: Under Article 312 the All India Services are the IAS, IPS and Indian Forest Service.

new.s: Which of the following central agencies needs State consent to investigate in a State?
new.x: Only the CBI needs State consent, under Section 6 of the DSPE Act, 1946; the NIA and ED do not.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: The CBI works under the DSPE Act, 1946; the ED under PMLA 2002 and FEMA 1999; the NIA under the NIA Act, 2008.

new.s: In the GST Council, the vote weight of the Centre is:
new.x: The Centre has one-third of the weighted vote and the States two-thirds; decisions need a three-fourths majority.

new.s: In Mohit Minerals (May 2022), the Supreme Court held that GST Council recommendations are:
o: Binding on both Union and States
new.x: Mohit Minerals held that GST Council recommendations are not binding on the Union and States; they have persuasive value.

new.s: The share of the divisible pool recommended for States by the 16th Finance Commission (2026-31) is:
new.x: The 16th FC keeps 41%; States wanted 50%, while the 14th FC had given 42%.

new.s: In its opinion of 20 November 2025 on a Presidential Reference, the Supreme Court held that:
o: Courts can fix timelines for the Governor's assent
No court-imposed timelines apply to the Governor or President
Deemed assent is part of the Constitution
The Governor must assent within four months
new.x: The 5-judge bench held there are no court-imposed timelines under Articles 200 and 201, and deemed assent is alien to the Constitution.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Governor-State conflicts?
o: Bill assent delays arose in Tamil Nadu and Kerala
In State of Tamil Nadu v Governor (April 2025), the SC set timelines for assent
The Presidential Reference was made under Article 143
new.x: The November 2025 opinion called deemed assent alien to the Constitution; the other statements are correct.

new.s: The Kurian Joseph Committee, which seeks a 'structural reset' of federal relations, was set up by:
new.x: The Kurian Joseph Committee was appointed by Tamil Nadu; Part I came on 16 February 2026.

new.s: The 11th and last meeting of the Inter-State Council was held on:
new.x: The Inter-State Council's 11th meeting, the last, was held on 16 July 2016.

new.s: How many Union Cabinet ministers are members of the Inter-State Council?
new.x: Members include CMs, UT administrators, Governors of States under President's Rule and six Union Cabinet ministers.

new.s: The Centre's main reason for denying Special Category Status was the stand of the:
new.x: The 14th FC raised devolution to 42% and drew no distinction between special and general category States.

new.s: Which Article provides for local cadres, education and jobs in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Article 371D covers AP's local cadres, education and jobs; 371E provides for a Central University in AP.

new.s: How many States were granted Special Category Status?
new.x: Eleven States were granted SCS, e.g. Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh and J&K; Bihar never was.

new.s: Special Category Status criteria applied by the NDC are known as the:
new.x: The NDC granted SCS using Gadgil formula criteria such as hilly terrain, border location and backwardness.

new.s: The Rajamannar Committee was appointed by the Tamil Nadu DMK government headed by:
new.x: The DMK government under Karunanidhi appointed it in 1969, taking forward Annadurai's 1967 view.

new.s: The Rajamannar Committee aimed to reduce central control over which two subjects, following Annadurai's 1967 view?
new.x: Its aim was to reduce central control, including over education and health, building on C.N. Annadurai's 1967 view.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT a recommendation of the Rajamannar Committee?
new.x: Rajamannar did not recommend strengthening the Governor (APPSC-G2 2017); the others were its recommendations.

new.s: On the Finance Commission, the Rajamannar Committee recommended that it be:
new.x: Rajamannar wanted the Finance Commission revitalised and revenue devolution widened.

new.s: The Rajamannar Committee recommended that residuary powers be vested in the:
new.x: Rajamannar wanted residuary powers given to the States; Sarkaria put non-tax residuary matters in the Concurrent List.

new.s: The DMK slogan linked to the Rajamannar report was:
o: Autonomy for the States, federalism at the Centre
new.x: The DMK slogan was 'autonomy for the States, federalism at the Centre'.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the aftermath of the Rajamannar report:
1. The Tamil Nadu Assembly adopted a State autonomy resolution in April 1974.
2. The Inter-State Council of 1990 was set up on its recommendation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The TN resolution came in April 1974; the ISC (1990) came through Sarkaria, not Rajamannar.

new.s: Besides Justice R.S. Sarkaria, the members of the Sarkaria Commission were B. Sivaraman and:
new.x: The other members were B. Sivaraman and Dr S.R. Sen; Chandra Reddy and Mudaliar were on the Rajamannar Committee.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT a Sarkaria recommendation on the Governor?
o: Chief Minister to be effectively consulted
Should have travelled extensively in the State
new.x: 'Travelled extensively in the State' was not a criterion (APPSC-G2 2017); the others were recommended.

new.s: When there is doubt over a Ministry's majority, the Sarkaria Commission recommended:
o: A floor test in the Assembly
new.x: Sarkaria wanted majority tested on the floor of the Assembly, not by the Governor's own view.

new.s: On central armed forces, the Sarkaria Commission held that the Centre may deploy them in a State:
o: Only after a Rajya Sabha resolution
new.x: The Centre may deploy central forces even without a request, though consulting the State first is desirable.

new.s: The Sarkaria Commission recommended renaming the National Development Council as the:
new.x: Sarkaria proposed renaming the NDC as the National Economic and Development Council.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sarkaria Commission's financial recommendations:
1. The present division of functions between the Finance Commission and the Planning Commission was found reasonable.
2. The Planning Commission should be abolished.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Sarkaria found the present division of functions reasonable and wanted it to continue; Rajamannar wanted the Planning Commission abolished.

new.s: The Sarkaria Commission's proposed name for the permanent Inter-State Council was:
new.x: Sarkaria proposed a permanent council under Article 263 named the Inter-Governmental Council.

new.s: Of the Sarkaria Commission's 247 recommendations, how many were accepted or implemented (2013)?
new.x: Per a 2013 Lok Sabha reply, 180 were accepted/implemented, 65 not accepted and 2 under implementation.

new.s: The Inter-State Council was set up on Sarkaria's recommendation on:
new.x: The Inter-State Council was set up on 28 May 1990; its Secretariat followed in 1991.

new.s: Which commission on Centre-State relations recommended a 'localised emergency' and fixed tenure for Governors?
new.x: The Punchhi Commission (Centre, 2007) proposed a localised emergency and fixed Governor tenure.
